universal_truth_gate.policy: No proposer (frontier or low-tier) self-certifies lessons; every candidate must pass Truth Gate (BROKEN fails on expected property, FIXED passes positive/negative/near-miss/conservation controls) + held-out Utility Gate + 2-Strike Auto-Freeze.

capsules.when_clause: Share/staking vault converting assets <-> shares with yield/reward donations
capsules.invariant: Use ERC-4626 virtual offset (V_SHARES=10**6, V_ASSETS=1) with vault-favorable integer rounding (never float): deposit shares = (assets * (total_shares + V_SHARES)) // (total_assets + V_ASSETS) (floor); redeem assets = (shares * (total_assets + V_ASSETS)) // (total_shares + V_SHARES) (floor); mint required_assets = ceil; withdraw required_shares = ceil. PRECONDITION: shares > 0 holds ONLY when total_assets + V_ASSETS <= assets * (total_shares + V_SHARES); if donation exceeds V_SHARES * assets so floor yields 0 shares, callers MUST explicitly reject shares <= 0 (ValueError/revert).
capsules.pos_ast: V_S, V_A = 10**6, 1; shares = (assets * (self.total_shares + V_S)) // (self.total_assets + V_A); if shares <= 0: raise ValueError('zero shares')

capsules.when_clause: Concurrent multi-entity transfer/rebalance with per-key locks
capsules.invariant: Acquire distinct account locks in sorted order (first, second) = sorted((src, dst)); when src == dst (self-transfer), acquire ONLY ONE lock, check 0 < amount <= balance[src] (raise ValueError if insufficient), preserve total ledger sum conservation, and return cleanly without deadlocking.

capsules.when_clause: Binary hash/Merkle tree & inclusion proof verification (even under custom names)
capsules.invariant: Reject empty items (ValueError). Length-prefix leaf fields (len(id_bytes_4B_be) + id_bytes + int_str) with RFC-6962 b'\x00' leaf prefix and b'\x01' internal-node prefix. When a level has odd length (len(nodes) % 2 == 1), promote nodes[-1] unchanged WITHOUT duplicating ([A,B,C] root != [A,B,C,C] root). SIGNATURE-GUARDED: for -> bool proof verifiers return False (do NOT raise ValueError) when proof directions are not in ('L', 'R') or sibling hex is malformed.
capsules.pos_ast: leaf = sha256(b'\x00' + len(rb).to_bytes(4, 'big') + rb + str(qty).encode()).digest()  # odd node promoted unchanged

capsules.when_clause: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) prerequisite evaluation, ancestor aggregation & critical path
capsules.invariant: Validate unknown endpoints (ValueError), use iterative Kahn's topological sort (no deep recursion RecursionError on 500+ nodes, raise ValueError or CycleError(ValueError) if processed < len(nodes)), and propagate set[node_id] of distinct transitive ancestors so Diamond DAGs (A->B, A->C, B->D, C->D) NEVER double-count shared ancestor A.
capsules.pos_ast: anc[v] |= anc[u] | {u}  # iterative Kahn topological order; sum(base[x] for x in anc[m])

capsules.when_clause: Authenticated JSON webhook/packet verification & string field parsing
capsules.invariant: Sign with hmac.new(secret, f'{ts_or_epoch}.'.encode() + raw_body, sha256) (explicit '.' delimiter prevents boundary collision), verify via hmac.compare_digest. SIGNATURE-GUARDED: check abs(now - ts) <= max_skew ONLY if now_sec/max_skew_sec parameters exist on the method; bind idempotency key to sha256(raw_body) if idempotency parameter exists; reject Trojan Source Bidi chars (\u202a..\u202e, \u2066..\u2069, \u061c, \x00) in ALL decoded JSON string fields — for -> bool verifiers return False (do NOT raise), otherwise raise SecurityViolationError.
capsules.pos_ast: if any('\u202a'<=c<='\u202e' or '\u2066'<=c<='\u2069' or c in '\u061c\x00' for c in text): return False  # if -> bool else raise SecurityViolationError

capsules.invariant: Before calling subprocess.run([bin_real, flag, target_real], shell=False, check=False, timeout=5), reject shell/control metacharacters (;|&$><`\n\r\x00) in BOTH binary & argument strings (SecurityViolationError/ValueError), require os.path.isabs(bin) + os.access(bin_real, os.X_OK) + os.path.isfile(target_real).
capsules.pos_ast: if any(c in arg for c in ';|&$><`\n\r\x00') or not os.path.isfile(arg): raise SecurityViolationError('unsafe arg')

capsules.when_clause: Writing files under a workspace root directory
capsules.invariant: Canonicalize root once via root = os.path.realpath(workspace_root), reject symlinks on every relative segment (os.path.islink), enforce sibling-safe confinement target == root or target.startswith(root + os.sep) (blocks /ws_evil), and write atomically via os.open(..., O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600) + os.replace.
capsules.pos_ast: if not target.startswith(root + os.sep) or os.path.islink(cand): raise SecurityViolationError('escape')

capsules.invariant: First delivery for (idempotency_key, payload_hash) MUST create exactly 1 stock movement and debit/credit inventory; duplicate replay with identical key+payload returns stored receipt with 0 extra movements; same key with conflicting payload MUST fail closed (ValueError/409).
capsules.pos_ast: if key in seen: return seen[key] if seen[key].payload_hash == ph else raise ValueError('idempotency conflict')

capsules.invariant: Never parse DECIMAL/money columns via binary float/Number; construct Decimal(str(raw)), quantize at explicit currency precision (ROUND_HALF_UP), and verify sum(line_totals) == grand_total conservation with remainder allocated deterministically.
